case.question: How do I switch the EVK between USB power and a wall adapter?

result.question: How do I switch the EVK between USB power and a wall adapter?
result.answer: To switch the EVK between power sources, use Jumper 3 (JMP 3) [EVK-v1.1-p012-1]. Placing the jumper in the first position enables USB Type-C as the input voltage source, while the second position enables the +5V Adapter as the voltage source [EVK-v1.1-p012-1]. You must place the Power Input Jumper (JMP 3) according to the input power supply being used [EVK-v1.1-p016-1].

case.question: How can I tell that the module has joined the mobile network?
case.expected_behavior: Network status indication pin/LED (NET_STATUS); on the EVK the NETLIGHT LED.

result.question: How can I tell that the module has joined the mobile network?
result.answer: You can determine if the module has joined the mobile network using the NET_STATUS pin (pin 21 or 75) or AT commands. When the module is latched on to the network, the network indicator LED will be constantly bright [HW-v5.3-p040-1]. Alternatively, you can enable network registration unsolicited result codes using the AT+CEREG command to monitor the registration status [AT-v3.1-p039-1]. Once RF functionality is enabled via AT+CFUN=1, the NETLIGHT will transition from blinking while searching to stable when latched on to the network [EVK-v1.1-p018-1].
